snippet.title: Beyond The Blight - Steam Playtest Announcement
snippet.description:
Playtest on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4654240/Beyond_The_Blight/
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/BVFjHJTGt

Beyond the Blight is a first person, 2.5d incremental dungeon-crawler where you loot, upgrade, and grow stronger on the quest to find and defeat the source of the blight.
